unit: Marilla Cuthbert lived an unmarred, quiet life at Green Gables with her brother Matthew, managing their homestead. Wanting a young orphan boy to assist Matthew with farm work, they arranged through acquaintances to adopt one from Nova Scotia. Due to a misunderstanding, an eleven-year-old girl named Anne Shirley arrived instead. Though Marilla initially insisted on returning the orphan girl, she was moved by pity and Matthew's quiet persistence, agreeing to keep Anne and raise her properly. Over the next five years, Marilla navigated the challenges of raising an unusually imaginative, talkative, and impulsive girl. She strictly corrected Anne's outbursts, taught her prayers and catechism, and oversaw her schooling and home chores. Through various incidents—including Anne's temper explosion at Mrs. Rachel Lynde, her accidental intoxication of Diana Barry, the loss of Marilla's prized amethyst brooch, and Anne's green hair mishap—Marilla learned to temper her strictness with deep affection and a newfound sense of maternity. When Anne decided to quit school after being humiliated by her teacher, Marilla wisely sought Mrs. Lynde's advice and allowed Anne a brief respite to cool down. As Anne grew into an accomplished student, Marilla supported her education, consenting to her joining the Queen's Academy preparation class and later funding her studies at the Academy in Charlottetown. During Anne's absence, Marilla felt an aching loneliness at Green Gables.

unit: Marilla Cuthbert lived an unmarred, quiet life at Green Gables with her brother Matthew, managing their homestead. Wanting a young orphan boy to assist Matthew with farm work, they arranged through acquaintances to adopt one from Nova Scotia. She strictly corrected Anne's outbursts, taught her prayers and catechism, and oversaw her schooling and home chores. When Anne decided to quit school after being humiliated by her teacher, Marilla wisely sought Mrs. Lynde's advice and allowed Anne a brief respite to cool down. As Anne grew into an accomplished student, Marilla supported her education, consenting to her joining the Queen's Academy preparation class and later funding her studies at the Academy in Charlottetown. unit: Anne Shirley arrives at Bright River station expecting to be adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, only to discover they had requested a boy to help on their farm. Though Marilla initially intends to send her back, Matthew is charmed by Anne's vivid chatter, and Marilla ultimately decides to keep her at Green Gables. Anne quickly settles into Avonlea, forming a passionate 'bosom friendship' with Diana Barry. Her early years are marked by dramatic misadventures: she flies into a rage at Mrs. Rachel Lynde for insulting her hair, mistakenly intoxicates Diana with currant wine, smashes a slate over Gilbert Blythe's head for calling her 'Carrots,' and breaks her ankle attempting a dare on a roof. Later, Anne saves Diana's baby sister from croup, earns the forgiveness of Diana's mother, and accidentally dyes her own hair green, necessitating a short haircut. At school, she enters a fierce academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe. She enters Queen's Academy, ties with Gilbert for first place on the entrance exams, wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship, and completes her First Class teacher's license in one year. Following the sudden death of Matthew Cuthbert from heart failure and Marilla's failing eyesight, Anne selflessly gives up her college scholarship to remain at Green Gables and teach at the Avonlea school. She finally forgives Gilbert Blythe, ending their long-standing feud to become close friends.
